faqs.answer:
👋 Hello! Welcome to Hi-Tech Pathology Lab. I'm here to help you with information about our tests, booking, reports, timings, and more.

What would you like to know?

🧪 We offer a wide range of diagnostic services:

• 🩸 Blood Tests (CBC, Blood Sugar, Lipid Profile etc.)
• 🏥 Urine Analysis
• 🦠 COVID-19 Testing (RT-PCR & Rapid Antigen)
• 🫀 Thyroid & Hormone Tests (TSH, T3, T4)
• 🔬 Biochemistry (Liver, Kidney, Lipid Profile)
• 🧬 Tumor & Cancer Markers
• ⚡ Electrolyte Analysis
• 🩺 Complete Health Checkup Packages

Want details on any specific test?

🩸 Blood Tests at Hi-Tech Pathology Lab:

We perform all blood tests using the world-class **Medonic M Series CBC Analyzer** (made in Sweden).

• Complete Blood Count (CBC)
• Blood Glucose (Fasting / PP / Random)
• Hemoglobin (Hb)
• ESR, Blood Group & more

✅ Accurate results with state-of-the-art equipment.

To book, visit our lab or contact us on WhatsApp!

🦋 Thyroid & Immunoassay Tests:

We use the **Tosoh AiA 360** – a world-class Japanese analyzer for precise thyroid testing.

• TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone)
• T3 (Triiodothyronine)
• T4 (Thyroxine)
• Free T3 / Free T4
• Anti-TPO Antibodies

✅ Highly accurate results from a certified analyzer.

Book your test today!

🔬 Biochemistry Tests:

We use **Erba Chem 7 & Erba Chem 6** – Germany-manufactured analyzers for reliable results.

• Liver Function Test (LFT): SGPT, SGOT, Bilirubin
• Kidney Function Test (KFT): Creatinine, BUN, Uric Acid
• Lipid Profile: Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL, LDL
• Blood Glucose, HbA1c, and more

Contact us or visit the lab for prices.

🎗️ Cancer & Tumor Marker Tests:

We use the **Tosoh AiA 360 Immunoassay Analyzer** for cancer marker testing.

• PSA (Prostate Specific Antigen)
• CEA (Carcinoembryonic Antigen)
• AFP (Alpha-Fetoprotein)
• CA-125, CA 19-9 and more

Early detection matters. Consult your doctor and book your test with us.

⚡ Electrolyte Analysis:

We use a **Micro Lab Electrolyte Analyzer** (world-class Indian-manufactured system).

• Sodium (Na)
• Potassium (K)
• Chloride (Cl)
• Bicarbonate

Electrolyte tests help detect dehydration, kidney disease, and more.

😷 COVID-19 Testing:

We offer certified and safe COVID-19 testing:

• 🔬 RT-PCR Test (Gold Standard)
• ⚡ Rapid Antigen Test (Quick Result)

Safe sample collection, accurate and timely results.

Contact us or visit for current availability and pricing.

💧 Urine Analysis:

We provide quick and reliable urine tests:

• Urine Routine & Microscopy
• Urine Culture & Sensitivity
• Urine Protein, Glucose
• 24-hour Urine Tests

✅ Fast turnaround with accurate results.

🏥 Health Checkup Packages:

📦 **Basic Health Checkup** (POPULAR)
Comprehensive preventive screening for routine monitoring and early detection.

📦 **Advanced Health Checkup** (PREMIUM)
Complete diagnostic package: blood investigations, organ function tests, and detailed health assessment.

Great value for your health! Visit our lab or contact us on WhatsApp to know the price and book.

📄 Do You Need a Doctor's Prescription?

For most routine tests, you do NOT need a prescription. You can walk in and request any test.

However, for certain specialized tests or packages, a doctor's referral may be helpful.

When in doubt, feel free to contact us on WhatsApp or call us!

🍽️ Test Preparation – Fasting:

For accurate results, **fasting is required** for some tests:

✅ **Fast 8–12 hours before:**
• Blood Sugar (Fasting)
• Lipid Profile (Cholesterol)
• Liver Function Test (LFT)

❌ **No fasting needed for:**
• CBC, Urine Tests
• Thyroid (TSH) – morning sample preferred

If unsure, please ask your doctor or call us!
